C1.justification: The repo contains a GPS module (gps_module_present=true, gps_conv_class=true) and supports scheme switching in an example (qm9_example_supports_scheme_switching=true) with many MPNN backbones available, consistent with a unified framework with toggleable schemes.

C2.justification: The HydraGNN GitHub repository is publicly cloneable (clone_verified=true) and runnable end-to-end on a QM9 smoke test, but the evidence does not show reproduction of the paper’s full benchmark suite or exact reported numbers.

C3.justification: On the QM9 smoke run, adding GPS increased peak GPU memory from 0.0755 GB (S1) to 0.1174 GB (S3), a measured +55.6% overhead, supporting meaningful memory cost vs plain MPNN.

C4.justification: The evidence only includes a 2-epoch QM9 subset smoke test comparing S1 vs S3 and provides no results for S2/S4 or the 7 benchmarks (including OGB-PPA/PCBA), so the claimed performance patterns cannot be evaluated.

one_line: Core framework components and GPS memory overhead are supported by repo inspection and a QM9 smoke run, but the paper’s benchmark-level performance claims (especially C4) were not tested here.
